races.paceDynamic: Expound is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate a comfortable pace without pressure from rivals. War Correspondent, Hasten Slowly, Donnrua Dream, You Done Well and Lincall are the prominent racers but none are aggressive early types. The substantial hold-up brigade of Oh So Charming, Redwood Queen, Tell Us This, Desert Cave and Migdam will rely on the race developing into a sprint finish. This uncontested lead scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy, as the hold-up horses will face a wall of runners when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Expound maintains his rhythm and stays jumping soundly throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a strong finish while the hold-up horses struggle to make ground. His recent course form and front-running style perfectly suits this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners settles perfectly behind Expound and times their challenge
scenarios.body: War Correspondent or Hasten Slowly can track the leader without fighting for position then strike when the pace quickens. Their class and tactical positioning advantage overwhelms the held-up brigade who get caught too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and opens up the race completely
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine speed allows patient types like Oh So Charming or Redwood Queen to wind up from the back with devastating late runs. Their superior class ratings can overcome positional disadvantages when the race becomes a pure stamina test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Expound fails to handle the ground or jumping pressure builds unexpectedly
scenarios.body: The race fragments with no clear pace narrative, creating opportunities for unexposed types like Migdam or improvers. Tactical chaos favours horses with less obvious profiles who can adapt to unusual race dynamics.

races.paceDynamic: Crooked Path is the clear front runner with a consistent prominent style and should set a sustainable pace without early pressure. The large field of 17 runners contains mostly hold-up horses (Hey Now, Crystal Yeats, Whet The Appetite, Goodmancon, Le Tatoue Madrik, Zuzukel, Cornaroya Rocco, Youknowthecode, Baby Fish) with only Nameyourgame and Davitts Quay likely to race prominently behind the leader. With one pace-setter and limited early speed, this creates a tactical race where the tempo may be modest early before quickening from the final hurdle. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the likely sprint finish and avoid early exertion in the soft conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Crooked Path sets uncontested fractions and the race becomes a sprint from two out
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks. Those with proven form at the trip and stamina reserves will dominate the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Crooked Path goes too slow early and gets swamped before the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with no clear tempo, suiting horses that can adapt quickly. Those racing closer to the pace avoid the inevitable traffic problems in the large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the experienced horses underperform and the lightly-raced newcomers show significant improvement
scenarios.body: The betting market gets turned upside down with an unexposed runner capitalizing on the tactical nature. Fresh horses with point-to-point experience could translate that stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Persists
scenarios.trigger: If Crooked Path kicks clear approaching the last and the chasers fail to respond quickly enough
scenarios.body: The prominent runner uses tactical advantage to steal crucial lengths before the sprint. Those closest in the betting with finishing speed arrive too late despite the soft ground assisting stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Time Is A Thief is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable tempo in this large field of largely inexperienced horses. With most runners showing hold-up tendencies or unknown styles, the pace will likely be moderate early before quickening from the second-last hurdle. The lack of early pace pressure means Time Is A Thief can dictate terms, while the hold-up brigade will need to rely on stamina and finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven staying power who can track the leader without getting too far back in a big field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Time Is A Thief gets an easy lead and maintains galloping room
scenarios.body: The Henry de Bromhead-trained gelding can use his tactical speed to build an unassailable advantage before the field can mount serious challenges. His prominent style perfectly suits controlling the tempo against this largely inexperienced opposition.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and the field compacts turning for home
scenarios.body: The numerous hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty to aim at in the straight. The Monkey Pole and Lord Lackendarra have the best finishing records among the patient types.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the yielding ground and 2m4f trip finds out the less experienced runners
scenarios.body: Proven stayers with course experience gain a crucial edge as others fade from the second-last. Lord Lackendarra's extensive experience at this trip becomes decisive against the lightly-raced newcomers.

scenarios.body: China Grill or Blues Street from powerful connections could exploit the tactical race scenario. Their unknown quantities status works in their favour if connections have them primed.

races.paceDynamic: Kimy looks the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner handicap hurdle, meaning he can dictate terms without pressure from the outset. Prince Of Air, Kilbarry Ce Ce, Brave Soldier, Go Gill Go and Mollys Dolly are prominent racers who may track the early leader, but none are natural pace pressers. The bulk of this field comprises hold-up horses including Bossing It, Miss Donna, Maxicourt, Synchronize and Sheer Raz who will settle towards the rear. This setup creates a tactical race where Kimy can control the fractions, building a sustainable rhythm that will test the finishing kicks of the back markers over this stamina-sapping 2m½f trip on yielding ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kimy Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Kimy gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady rhythm without early pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back, while prominent racers get first run on the weakening hold-up horses. The yielding ground and competitive handicap nature suits horses who can travel strongly in behind the leader rather than rely on late kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Of Air, Kilbarry Ce Ce or Brave Soldier press Kimy early and force stronger fractions
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will set up the race for the hold-up horses who can produce their finishing kicks. Bossing It and Maxicourt have proven stamina at this trip and grade to capitalize on a truly run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady but the hold-up brigade finds their rhythm perfectly timed
scenarios.body: The back markers get their preferred scenario with a moderate pace followed by a sprint finish. Sheer Raz and Stumblin In have tactical speed to produce late rallies, though they need everything to fall right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the market principles fail to fire and the race becomes messy with no clear pace scenario
scenarios.body: A longshot who gets the right trip can capitalize on the favorite's misfortunes. Go Gill Go has experience at this level despite his low rating, while Liss Eile has place form in similar company.

races.paceDynamic: Jetaway Nana is the standout early pace angle as the only confirmed front runner, likely to set a steady tempo alongside prominent runners Roccabaker and Lady Bluebird. With such a large field (19 runners) but limited early speed, the pace should be sustainable rather than searching, allowing the early leaders to dictate terms without severe pressure. The vast majority of this field are hold-up performers who will need the race to develop into a sprint finish to be effective. This pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and kick from a good position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Jetaway Nana and the prominent runners maintain their positions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows those racing handy to control the race and kick clear when the field bunches up behind them. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground through the pack in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the field stays tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: This creates opportunities for the better hold-up performers with tactical speed to weave through and finish strongly. Those with proven finishing kicks can capitalise on a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners fade and the hold-up horses get caught in traffic
scenarios.body: Runners positioned in mid-division can avoid both the early pace pressure and the traffic problems affecting those held up. They get first run on the leaders while having cover early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform or encounter jumping/traffic issues
scenarios.body: This opens the door for lightly-weighted runners with fewer expectations to capitalise on a truly-run race. The handicapper's assessment proves generous.

races.paceDynamic: Long Road and Toor Moon will lead from the off, with Long Road's recent front-running wins giving him confidence to dictate. These two pacesetting leaders should create an honest gallop over this stamina-testing trip, especially with 17 runners needing to find position early. The large field means prominent runners like Oogum Boogum, Ossifer Hops and Lake Chad will look to track the leaders closely rather than get caught behind horses. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick off tired leaders in the closing stages, as the early pace battle should set up perfectly for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Long Road and Toor Moon go too hard early and fade from 2 out
scenarios.body: The honest early gallop sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Quality closers with tactical speed get the perfect setup to unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest but sustainable throughout
scenarios.body: The two leaders maintain their advantage while the hold-up horses struggle to make up enough ground. Prominent trackers who avoided the early battle get first run on the fading leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Too Slow
scenarios.trigger: If Long Road and Toor Moon go too slowly early causing bunching
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last mile with horses still on the bridle. Those with tactical pace and good positions can quicken decisively when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leaders Wire Field
scenarios.trigger: If Long Road and Toor Moon judge the pace perfectly and kick clear
scenarios.body: The two pacesetting leaders maintain their advantage to the line despite late challenges. Their early positioning and stamina reserves prove decisive over this demanding trip.

watchPoints.text: Long Road and Toor Moon's early battle could be vicious with both natural front-runners, potentially setting up dramatic late collapse
Let Him B's tendency to fade in the finish despite early promise makes him unreliable for win purposes
Several horses carry headgear changes including Long Road, Oogum Boogum, and Rideau Canal suggesting recent issues
The 5lb claiming jockeys on Oogum Boogum and Lake Chad provide significant weight advantages in this competitive handicap
Byrnes stable runs both Let Him B and Opposite Ends from just 4 days ago, suggesting both are spot-on for this target

races.paceDynamic: The Happy Huntsman will dictate terms from the front with minimal pressure, as most rivals prefer to sit off the pace or hold up. Six prominent runners including I Walked The Line, Cold Old Fire, Lawful Ruler, Pirate Island, Roman Parish and Ta Se Rua create congestion behind the leader, setting up traffic problems turning for home. With limited early pace pressure, The Happy Huntsman can control fractions before the prominent group engages 3-4 out. This controlled tempo followed by late congestion strongly favours hold-up horses who can find clear runs wide in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Happy Huntsman gets an uncontested lead and the prominent group gets shuffled approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows closers to finish strongly while traffic problems compromise the prominent runners. Clean runs from the back prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure an ideal tracking position and avoid the inevitable traffic jam
scenarios.body: Cold Old Fire or I Walked The Line uses class to muscle through when the pace lifts. The winner comes from those close enough to strike but positioned to avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If The Happy Huntsman faces no serious challenge until too late and the field struggles to close the gap
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field gets bogged down behind. By the time they organize a challenge, the race is over.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes even slower than expected and multiple horses make their moves simultaneously
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with no clear advantage to any running style. The winner emerges from a blanket finish decided by which horse handles the soft ground best.

watchPoints.text: The Happy Huntsman getting too soft a lead early - if unopposed for first mile he could steal the race
Traffic problems 3 furlongs out when six prominent runners try to improve position simultaneously behind the leader
Cold Old Fire and I Walked The Line getting clear runs - their class could overcome tactical disadvantages
Late-declared runners changing the pace dynamic, particularly if any show early speed
Ground conditions deteriorating further, which would emphasize the advantage to hold-up horses even more
